video_title: 🎤 PWat on the mic for Media Day, presented by @clevelandclinic! #nba #cleveland #cavs #basketball

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.text: Good to meet you Cayden, Demetrius. Good to meet you boy. I am looking forward to interacting with you guys and embracing the city of Cleveland for sure. Let them know.
quotes.news_angle: Peyton Watson expresses excitement about joining the Cleveland Cavaliers and engaging with the community.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson is ready to get to work and embrace the city of Cleveland. He is looking forward to interacting with the fans and the community this season.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.text: The funniest guy on my team is Nae'Qwan Tomlin. Where do I start? This is what I came for. I am on fire, baby. Cooking with gas.
quotes.news_angle: Peyton Watson identifies Nae'Qwan Tomlin as the funniest player on the Cleveland Cavaliers roster.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says Nae'Qwan Tomlin is the funniest guy on the Cleveland Cavaliers team.
